text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару and I are having
lunch
together one day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Do you think I'll get luscious, bouncy
skin if I eat
this Luscious, Bouncy
Pudding?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Arghhh! Then what am I supposed to do
about my
skin? It's as dry and rough as a
paper talisman!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The philosophy of feng shui tells us dry
skin is a
surefire sign that great
misfortune is just around
the corner!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару seems to be having
skin
problems...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
